Definition: Azubah, the name of two Israelitesses
BiblicalUsage: Azubah is the name of two women — the wife of Caleb, the mother of Jerioth, Jesher, Shobab and Ardon, and the mother of Jehoshaphat, the daughter of Shilhi. One Azubah built a family in the wilderness generation, and the other raised a king who sought the Lord.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe mothers shape kingdoms: one Azubah bore Caleb's sons, and the other bore a king who walked in the ways of his father Asa, and both are remembered by name.
